findings.message: Removing defer resp.Body.Close() leaks the response body (and underlying connection) on early returns: if os.Create fails or io.Copy returns an error, Fetch returns without closing resp.Body. The explicit Close after io.Copy only covers the success path.
findings.suggestion: Restore defer resp.Body.Close() immediately after the err check (and remove the manual close), so the body is closed on all return paths.

findings.message: resp.Body is only closed on the success path; if copy fails (err != nil) the function returns early without closing resp.Body, leaking the connection/resource. The added Close should cover both paths.
findings.suggestion: Close resp.Body immediately after obtaining it (e.g. defer resp.Body.Close() right after the response is received) or close it in the error branch before returning.
